잠언-27-1.title: 잠언 27장 1절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-27-1.exegesis: 28. Men hate those they injure. A lying tongue-- "lips" for the persons (compare Pr 4:24 ; Psa 12:3 ).
잠언-27-1.theologicalNote: 28. Men hate those they injure. A lying tongue-- "lips" for the persons (compare Pr 4:24 ; Psa 12:3 ).

잠언-27-2.title: 잠언 27장 2절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-27-2.exegesis: CHAPTER 27 Pr 27:1-27 . 1. Do not confide implicitly in your plans ( Pr 16:9 ; 19:21 ; Jas 4:13-15 ).
잠언-27-2.theologicalNote: CHAPTER 27 Pr 27:1-27 . 1. Do not confide implicitly in your plans ( Pr 16:9 ; 19:21 ; Jas 4:13-15 ).

잠언-27-4.title: 잠언 27장 4절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-27-4.exegesis: 3. heavy-- The literal sense of "heavy," applied to material subjects, illustrates its figurative, "grievous," applied to moral. a fool's wrath-- is unreasonable and excessive.
잠언-27-4.theologicalNote: 3. heavy-- The literal sense of "heavy," applied to material subjects, illustrates its figurative, "grievous," applied to moral. a fool's wrath-- is unreasonable and excessive.

잠언-27-5.title: 잠언 27장 5절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-27-5.exegesis: 4. envy-- or, "jealousy" (compare Margin; Pr 6:34 ), is more unappeasable than the simpler bad passions.
잠언-27-5.theologicalNote: 4. envy-- or, "jealousy" (compare Margin; Pr 6:34 ), is more unappeasable than the simpler bad passions.

잠언-27-6.title: 잠언 27장 6절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-27-6.exegesis: 5-6. secret love-- not manifested in acts is useless; and even, if its exhibition by rebukes wounds us, such love is preferable to the frequent (compare Margin), and hence deceitful, kisses of an enemy.
잠언-27-6.theologicalNote: 5-6. secret love-- not manifested in acts is useless; and even, if its exhibition by rebukes wounds us, such love is preferable to the frequent (compare Margin), and hence deceitful, kisses of an enemy.

잠언-27-7.title: 잠언 27장 7절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-27-7.exegesis: 5-6. secret love-- not manifested in acts is useless; and even, if its exhibition by rebukes wounds us, such love is preferable to the frequent (compare Margin), and hence deceitful, kisses of an enemy.
잠언-27-7.theologicalNote: 5-6. secret love-- not manifested in acts is useless; and even, if its exhibition by rebukes wounds us, such love is preferable to the frequent (compare Margin), and hence deceitful, kisses of an enemy.

잠언-27-8.title: 잠언 27장 8절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-27-8.exegesis: 7. The luxury of wealth confers less happiness than the healthy appetite of labor.
잠언-27-8.theologicalNote: 7. The luxury of wealth confers less happiness than the healthy appetite of labor.

잠언-27-9.title: 잠언 27장 9절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-27-9.exegesis: 8. Such are not only out of place, but out of duty and in danger.
잠언-27-9.theologicalNote: 8. Such are not only out of place, but out of duty and in danger.

잠언-27-10.title: 잠언 27장 10절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-27-10.exegesis: 9. rejoice the heart-- the organ of perceiving what pleases the senses. sweetness ... counsel-- or, "wise counsel is also pleasing."
잠언-27-10.theologicalNote: 9. rejoice the heart-- the organ of perceiving what pleases the senses. sweetness ... counsel-- or, "wise counsel is also pleasing."

잠언-27-11.title: 잠언 27장 11절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-27-11.exegesis: 10. Adhere to tried friends. The ties of blood may be less reliable than those of genuine friendship.
잠언-27-11.theologicalNote: 10. Adhere to tried friends. The ties of blood may be less reliable than those of genuine friendship.

잠언-27-12.title: 잠언 27장 12절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-27-12.exegesis: 11. The wisdom of children both reflects credit on parents and contributes to their aid in difficulties.
잠언-27-12.theologicalNote: 11. The wisdom of children both reflects credit on parents and contributes to their aid in difficulties.

잠언-27-15.title: 잠언 27장 15절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-27-15.exegesis: 14. Excessive zeal in praising raises suspicions of selfishness.
잠언-27-15.theologicalNote: 14. Excessive zeal in praising raises suspicions of selfishness.

잠언-27-16.title: 잠언 27장 16절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-27-16.exegesis: 15. (Compare Pr 19:13 ). very ... day-- literally, "a day of showers."
잠언-27-16.theologicalNote: 15. (Compare Pr 19:13 ). very ... day-- literally, "a day of showers."

잠언-27-17.title: 잠언 27장 17절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-27-17.exegesis: 16. hideth-- or, "restrains" (that is, tries to do it); is as fruitless an effort, as that of holding the wind. the ointment of his right hand-- the organ of power ( Psa 17:7 ; 18:35 ). His right hand endeavors to repress perfume, but vainly. Some prefer: "His right hand comes on oil," that is, "cannot take hold." Such a woman cannot be tamed.
잠언-27-17.theologicalNote: 16. hideth-- or, "restrains" (that is, tries to do it); is as fruitless an effort, as that of holding the wind. the ointment of his right hand-- the organ of power ( Psa 17:7 ; 18:35 ). His right hand endeavors to repress perfume, but vainly. Some prefer: "His right hand comes on oil," that is, "cannot take hold." Such a woman cannot be tamed.

잠언-27-18.title: 잠언 27장 18절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-27-18.exegesis: 17. a man sharpeneth ... friend-- that is, conversation promotes intelligence, which the face exhibits.
잠언-27-18.theologicalNote: 17. a man sharpeneth ... friend-- that is, conversation promotes intelligence, which the face exhibits.

잠언-27-19.title: 잠언 27장 19절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-27-19.exegesis: 18. Diligence secures a reward, even for the humble servant.
잠언-27-19.theologicalNote: 18. Diligence secures a reward, even for the humble servant.

잠언-27-20.title: 잠언 27장 20절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-27-20.exegesis: 19. We may see our characters in the developed tempers of others.
잠언-27-20.theologicalNote: 19. We may see our characters in the developed tempers of others.

잠언-27-21.title: 잠언 27장 21절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-27-21.exegesis: 20. Men's cupidity is as insatiable as the grave.
잠언-27-21.theologicalNote: 20. Men's cupidity is as insatiable as the grave.

잠언-27-22.title: 잠언 27장 22절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-27-22.exegesis: 21. Praise tests character. a man to his praise-- according to his praise, as he bears it. Thus vain men seek it, weak men are inflated by it, wise men disregard it, &c.
잠언-27-22.theologicalNote: 21. Praise tests character. a man to his praise-- according to his praise, as he bears it. Thus vain men seek it, weak men are inflated by it, wise men disregard it, &c.

잠언-27-23.title: 잠언 27장 23절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-27-23.exegesis: 22. The obstinate wickedness of such is incurable by the heaviest inflictions.
잠언-27-23.theologicalNote: 22. The obstinate wickedness of such is incurable by the heaviest inflictions.

잠언-27-24.title: 잠언 27장 24절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-27-24.exegesis: 23-24. flocks-- constituted the staple of wealth. It is only by care and diligence that the most solid possessions can be perpetuated ( Pr 23:5 ).
잠언-27-24.theologicalNote: 23-24. flocks-- constituted the staple of wealth. It is only by care and diligence that the most solid possessions can be perpetuated ( Pr 23:5 ).

잠언-27-25.title: 잠언 27장 25절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-27-25.exegesis: 23-24. flocks-- constituted the staple of wealth. It is only by care and diligence that the most solid possessions can be perpetuated ( Pr 23:5 ).
잠언-27-25.theologicalNote: 23-24. flocks-- constituted the staple of wealth. It is only by care and diligence that the most solid possessions can be perpetuated ( Pr 23:5 ).

잠언-27-26.title: 잠언 27장 26절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-27-26.exegesis: 25-27. The fact that providential arrangements furnish the means of competence to those who properly use them is another motive to diligence (compare Psa 65:9-13 ). The hay appeareth-- literally, "Grass appeareth" ( Job 40:15 ; Psa 104:14 ).
잠언-27-26.theologicalNote: 25-27. The fact that providential arrangements furnish the means of competence to those who properly use them is another motive to diligence (compare Psa 65:9-13 ). The hay appeareth-- literally, "Grass appeareth" ( Job 40:15 ; Psa 104:14 ).
